name: cheapest-domains
description: Find domain names you can afford to keep. Compare annual renewal prices across selected registrars, with first-year registration prices and multi-year estimates shown separately. Check suggested names and show their availability status with read-only tools.

interface.shortDescription: Compare renewal prices. Find domains you can afford to keep.
interface.longDescription: Focus on the real cost of keeping a domain: its annual renewal price. Compare selected registrars, with initial registration prices shown separately and supported multi-year estimates. Your assistant suggests names and checks availability and premium status. Preserve source dates, partial coverage and unknown results. Renewal rates can change; purchases and exact premium prices remain at the registrar. Optional Cloudflare Radar data measures DNS popularity, not Google search competition.
defaultPrompt: Suggest domain names for my project with low annual renewals.
Compare current .com renewal prices across registrars.
Find domain extensions under $15 per year to renew.
